$comment: Divergences between docs/plan/rls-policy-matrix.md and the schema that are deliberate. check_rls_matrix.py refuses to pass on anything not either fixed or listed here, and warns when a waiver stops matching anything -- a waiver for something that no longer diverges is its own small lie. Every entry needs a reason a stranger can evaluate, not just an id.

waivers.reason: Not built. Phase 7's model half needs Vertex AI and GCP billing (client action 1). The deterministic half shipped without it.

Deliberate, and narrower than it was. The matrix gives a participant `R:part (status, amount)`; the grant is wider because a provider legitimately needs the amount breakdown that decides their own earnings, and a customer needs the fee and discount lines to understand what they paid. What was genuinely wrong -- `checkout_url`, which is a capability rather than a reference -- is revoked in 20260922121400_matrix_gaps.sql and moved behind `get_payment_checkout`, which checks the caller is the payer.
waivers.action: Correct the matrix cell to name the columns the product actually needs.

waivers.reason: Not a divergence. The matrix gives Support plain `R + F` on support_tickets -- they own the queue -- and the `R:scope` in that row belongs to the Dispute column, which the policy denies entirely. Narrower than specified, and fail-closed.
waivers.action: None. The heuristic reads the row, not the column.

waivers.reason: Narrower than specified, deliberately. The matrix gives Support `R:scope` on a user's notifications; the policy gives own-only and no admin clause at all. Reading somebody's notification history is the kind of blanket access S.1 was about, and support has the ticket thread for context.
waivers.action: Correct the matrix, or widen deliberately if support genuinely needs it.

waivers.reason: Narrower than specified. The matrix gives `R:part`, which would make read receipts possible; the policy gives own-only, so a 'seen' indicator has no backend. Fail-closed and harmless, but it is a product gap rather than a security one and the contract should not imply the feature works.
waivers.action: Decide whether read receipts ship. If they do, widen to participants; if not, correct the matrix.

waivers.reason: Not a divergence. The matrix cell is `R:part (own submissions)` and the policy tests `submitted_by = auth.uid()`, which is exactly that. The heuristic looks for participation helpers and does not recognise an ownership column as satisfying a narrowed R:part.
